item.text: The middleware package already uses `blang/semver`, and the production interceptor chain is assembled in `internal/cmd/grpc.go`. I’ll add the context helpers and parser, then register the interceptor so request handlers receive the version.

The parser, context helpers, and production registration are in place. I added tests for missing, valid prefixed, valid unprefixed, and invalid headers; the middleware and command package tests are running now.

item.text:
Implemented `x-flipt-accept-server-version` handling in the [gRPC middleware](/app/internal/server/middleware/grpc/middleware.go). The new interceptor stores parsed versions in request context, accepts both `v1.0.0` and `1.0.0`, and falls back to `1.0.0` when the header is missing or invalid. It is registered in the [server interceptor chain](/app/internal/cmd/grpc.go).

Added focused tests. `go test ./internal/server/middleware/grpc ./internal/cmd` passed.
